title: TAT-3857 post-rebase perps smoke: unlock preload and live market rows

ensure-unlocked.intent: Open the preserved wallet so the lock step starts from a known unlocked state

home-before-lock.intent: Settle on wallet home before locking

lock.intent: End the previous unlocked Perps connection so the next unlock exercises a fresh preload

unlock.intent: Unlock the wallet, which is the trigger this PR adds for proactive Perps preload

settle-on-home.intent: Confirm the wallet home UI rendered after unlock without visiting any Perps route

dwell-on-home.intent: Give the unlock-triggered preload the same head start the PR measures for delayed cold entry

enter-perps.intent: Enter Perps for the first time in this session after the preload window

perps-home-state.intent: Assert live Perps market rows render, proving preloaded market data reached the UI

screenshot-perps-home.label: Perps home after unlock-triggered preload
screenshot-perps-home.intent: Show a reviewer the priced Perps market rows a user sees on first entry after unlock

open-market-list.intent: Open the full market browser, the second surface this PR instruments

market-list-state.intent: Assert the market browser renders a populated live market list

screenshot-market-list.label: Perps market browser rows
screenshot-market-list.intent: Show a reviewer the populated market browser a user sees after opening the full list
